title: Lens spelling correction response
description: The object the model is asked to return inside choices[0].message.content on the spell channel. One word in, the corrected word out. The app checks that the answer is one token, so a sentence in place of a word is refused.

results.description: Exactly one entry: the whole message is one item.

corrected.description: The word with its spelling corrected, or unchanged when it was spelled correctly.
